create.name: Johnson Chong
create.bio:
Johnson Chong is a New York-born breathwork teacher, yoga teacher and shamanic practitioner who now lives and works in Sydney. Over some twenty years he has trained in coaching, yoga (he is an experienced registered teacher who also trains new yoga, breathwork and meditation teachers), Reiki and other energy practices, and Human Design, and he was initiated into the shamanic lineage of the Q'ero people of the Peruvian Andes. He has lived on three continents, has given a TEDx talk on difficult family relationships, and wrote the book Sage Sapien: From Karma to Dharma.

His approach, which he calls the SAGE Journey, draws on the Andean medicine wheel together with Buddhist and yogic practice, breathwork, hands-on energy work and coaching, with the aim of helping people notice inherited family patterns and live with more freedom. He teaches through short self-paced online courses on breathwork, meditation and the basics of Buddhism, through workshops and trainings in Sydney, and through one-to-one mentoring by application. He has led group journeys to sacred places since 2012, including Bali, Nepal, Tibet and India; his current retreats are in the Blue Mountains, in Bhutan and in Peru's Sacred Valley, where he works alongside Andean teachers.

courses.title: SAGE Shamanic Breathwork Journey through the Medicine Wheel
courses.description: A self-paced online course of fifteen lessons that moves through six stages of the Andean medicine wheel, pairing each direction with breath practices, self-inquiry and reflection.

courses.title: 7 Day Transformational Breathwork & Meditation Course
courses.description: A one-week online programme for busy people: each day has a short lesson video, a breathwork or meditation practice of ten to twenty minutes and a journaling exercise, on themes such as presence, non-attachment and gratitude.

courses.title: Intro to Buddhism & Meditation Course
courses.description: A ten-module online introduction to Buddhist thought and practice, from the life of the Buddha and karma to meditation methods, written partly for people preparing for retreats in the Himalaya.

courses.title: 1:1 Shamanic Expansion Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring by application that combines shamanic energy work, coaching, breathwork and a Human Design reading, with assignments and an online library between sessions.

courses.title: Shamanic Medicine Retreat, Blue Mountains
courses.description: A four-day residential retreat in the Blue Mountains west of Sydney using breathwork, ceremony and body-based practice to look at patterns passed down through families. Places are offered after a short call.

courses.title: Bhutan Awaken Retreat
courses.description: An eight-day small-group pilgrimage based near Paro, visiting Buddhist temples and Tiger's Nest with daily practice and teaching woven around the visits.

free_resources.title: Johnson Chong on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided meditations and breathwork tracks on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Free 7 Day Shamanic Journey for Inner Freedom Challenge
free_resources.description: A free week of short guided practices sent by email, drawn from his shamanic and breathwork teaching.
